facts.fact: The Gambia Press Union's Secretary General says the Access to Information Act has been in force for more than a year; the document gives no year of enactment, so it is dated to publication.
The Gambia Press Union says it takes part in technical committees alongside the Information Commission, so the Commission is set up and working; dated to publication.

note: Unanswered requests and missing information officers are reported with no oversight body or court decision, so no applied fact.
